The production invoice handler (aws/functions/api/providers/production/moov-invoice.mjs, live since 2026-10-23 through the guarded overlay runs 39955069311 and 39955539299) reads and writes moov_invoices (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) and reads and inserts moov_invoice_customers; in this repository only the supabase migration grants those tables (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE to authenticated, ALL to service_role) and nothing grants checksops. The owner sent an invoice from Payments on 2026-10-23, so production holds at least the lines that send used; the read-only inspect records which of the pinned lines are held. If every pinned line is held the inspect reports already_applied true and nothing is applied (the pin is then recorded as verified live, not applied). SQL 112 grants SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE on moov_invoices and SELECT and INSERT on moov_invoice_customers to checksops and authenticated and changes nothing else. No later migration revokes these grants.
